old_description: With decades of expertise and a reputation of excellence, Heabler Metal Products offers everything from small repairs and custom prototype fabrication to large-scale component manufacturing and complex assemblies.
about:
Heabler Metal Products Inc. operates from Denver, Colorado, providing metal fabrication and repair services to a range of industrial sectors. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides a range of metal fabrication services including sheet metal shearing (up to 3/16 inch by 10 feet), CNC plasma cutting, 3D modeling, pipe and tube bending, various welding processes (TIG, MIG, spot, and stick), sawing and cutting, repair services, 13-foot CNC forming, and 4-foot rolling capabilities. The workflow follows a three-step process: quote request, estimation, and fabrication. The company handles projects from custom prototype fabrication to large-scale component manufacturing and complex assemblies.

The company lists Industrial IoT, critical infrastructure, and fintech among the sectors it serves, though specific customer names are not provided. Its repair services are highlighted as a distinct offering.

The company emphasizes decades of expertise and a reputation for excellence, offering services from small repairs to large-scale component manufacturing and complex assemblies.
